issues: Activated ability should set "activateFrom": "cemetery" because the source says "banish this from your cemetery".

Activated ability cost is incorrectly encoded with both "banishSelf" and malformed "banishFromCemetery" fields; encode the cost as banishing this card from cemetery rather than as a field/self banish cost.
The buff effect should affect each Fox of Invitation on your field, including the token just summoned; remove "otherOnly": true.
The buff targeting is incorrect: "buffFieldTrait" with "trait": "Fox of Invitation" does not match card name text. It should target Fox of Invitation by identity/name rather than trait.
Remove the "fanfare" keyword; this is a Spell and the source text does not have Fanfare.

Necrocharge clause should summon Luna, Soul Keeper from the deck, then shuffle. "tutorFromDeck" to field is incorrect; use a deck-to-field summon implementation and include the shuffle step if required by the engine/card conventions.
The second choose option should summon Mono, Garnet Rebel from your cemetery, not add it to hand/field via "tutorFromCemetery". Use a cemetery-to-field summon effect for the selected named card.

Fanfare is encoded incorrectly: after declaring a number and milling 5, the card should deal X damage to each enemy follower, where X equals the number of cards buried this way with the declared cost. The current encoding deals damage to only one enemy follower and uses an unrelated cemetery count filter.

To encode this correctly, the engine needs support for counting cards milled by this effect that match a chosen cost/value, e.g. a dynamic amount like "milledThisEffectMatchingChosenCostCount", plus an effect to deal damage to all enemy followers using that dynamic amount.

On Evolve is incorrectly encoded as a generic "tutorFromCemetery" with an invalid filter. The source requires selecting exactly 3 cards with different names in your cemetery, then adding them to hand only if all 3 have the same cost.
To encode this correctly, the engine needs support for multi-select from cemetery with uniqueness-by-name and a conditional check that selected cards share the same cost before moving them to hand.

Missing passive ability: "This card can't be played from the EX area while there are dormancy counters on it." The parsed card does not encode this restriction. The engine needs a passive EX-area play restriction based on counters on this card.

Start-of-main ability is left as a noop. It should, while this card is in your EX area, remove a dormancy counter from this card, and if there are no dormancy counters on it after that, summon it. The engine needs support for counter-based conditional remove-and-then-summon from EX area for the source card.
